provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]
written_before: any L4 number (control or title strip)
level_reason: L4 needs all 109 slices per px: level 0 would be ~500 GB of reads for the control and ~1.2 TB for w010-027; level 1 (4.8 um in-plane, depth still 2.4 um/slice, 2x2 mean) is ~4x less and keeps depth resolution, which is what the 10-20 um deposit and the face detection need
canvas_mapping: canvas px (i, j) -> level-1 (i // 2, j // 2); mesh-valid by the strip-a canvas_mask rule evaluated at canvas px (2i, 2j)

surface.smoothing: Gaussian along the slice axis, sigma 1 slice, kernel radius 4, edge-replicate; on the level-1 uint8 voxels as float32
surface.sheet: runs of consecutive slices with smoothed value > 93 (T_mid, frozen); the run containing slice 54, else the run whose nearest slice is closest to 54 (ties -> the lower-slice run)
surface.invalid: no run slice within +-25 slices (+-60 um) of slice 54
surface.faces: s_minus = first slice of the run, s_plus = last slice of the run

values.L4-: max of the RAW (unsmoothed) level-1 voxels over slices [s_minus - 8, s_minus + 2] (20 um = 8.3 -> 8 slices, 5 um = 2.1 -> 2), clipped to 0..108

pregate.strip: control 20260701183125-w028-037 only; tiles = block_ctl.tile_plan (24 intercol c11/c15/c19 + 40 text, seed 20260927)
pregate.cells: 4 x 4 per tile (~5 mm) on the level-1 grid, used iff >= 50 % mesh-valid and >= 50 % L4-valid
pregate.detector: block_freeze.py rules verbatim (tile split seed 20260928, T in 140..254, F = train intercol p95, T_d = argmax train recall), per face
pregate.specificity_rot90: frozen (T_d, F) applied to the cells of the rot-90 copies of all control tiles; flagged <= 5 %
pregate.specificity_synthetic: 100 synthetic no-ink sheets (one 512 x 512 cell each), matched noise: per-class voxel mean/std (sheet interior, 0-20 um outside each face, air) estimated from the control tiles, sheet centre wandering as a smooth field, thickness drawn from the control's s_plus - s_minus distribution; flagged <= 5 %
pregate.verdict_per_face: PASS iff sensitivity and both specificity bars hold

title_strip: only for a face that passes, after PREGATE_L4.json is pushed
